observations: Photo 0: Multiple white plastic IBC totes in galvanized metal cages on wooden pallets, stacked two high outdoors; one tote has a small red mark; watermarks "BOLT WORLD" and "POSTED ON JIJI".
Photo 1: More stacked IBC totes; visible rust on cage bars and pallet edges; same watermarks.
Photo 2: Single IBC tote on pallet in foreground; black plastic tanks and a truck in background; same watermarks.

claims.claim: It's often used to store or transport liquid bulk
claims.evidence: Photos show IBC totes, which are built for that use, but this unit's history cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Unknown previous contents or chemical residue inside the tank
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the top fill cap and bottom valve, plus seller's written statement of the last product carried
risks.if_unproven: priced as contaminated with unknown residue

risks.risk: Leaking or seized bottom outlet valve
risks.proof: Video showing the valve being opened and closed with no drips, or a fill test

risks.risk: Rust or broken welds on the metal cage or rotten pallet
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cage corners, base frame, and pallet boards

proof_requests: Close-up of the top opening and bottom valve
Video of the valve operating without leaking
Close-up of cage welds and pallet condition
Seller's statement of the last contents
response.reason: The item is clearly a used IBC tote, so it can be priced at its worst case (unknown residue, non-sealing valve, rusted cage) even without further proof.
